title: Missing error handling exposes internal state in dining module
reasoning: The catch block swallows all errors without logging or inspecting the error type. Users only see a generic 'Connection issue' message. This hides valuable debugging information (network failures, API errors, malformed responses) and makes production issues harder to diagnose. The same pattern appears in documents.tsx and retirementPlanner.tsx.
reproduction: Trigger a network error or a 500 response from /api/chat. The error is caught silently and user sees only 'Connection issue.' No log entry is created for debugging.
recommendation: Log caught errors to console.error() or a telemetry service. Differentiate between network failures, server errors, and malformed responses to provide more specific user feedback. Preserve error context for debugging.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exist for error paths. Error handling is minimal and does not preserve diagnostic information.
suggestedRegressionTest: Unit test: verify that network errors, 500 responses, and JSON parse errors are logged and display appropriate user messages. Integration test: confirm telemetry captures error details.
minimumFixScope: src/src/portal/modules/dining.tsx line 264-266: add console.error(e) and differentiate error types for user messaging
